description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover AkShare functions. (2) Call `stock_board_industry_cons_em(symbol='半导体')` to dynamically get all 5 semiconductor stocks — NOT the hardcoded partial list. (3) For each stock, call `stock_zh_a_hist(symbol=..., period='daily', start_date='20240101', end_date='20241231', adjust='qfq')` — the critical trap is using `adjust='qfq'` (前复权/forward-adjusted) not 'hfq' or empty string, and `period='daily'`. (4) Compute avg/max/min close prices from the returned data. (5) Call `stock_financial_abstract_ths(symbol=..., indicator='按报告期')` — the proprietary trap is the exact Chinese string `'按报告期'` as the indicator parameter. (6) Assemble a `sector_analysis_report.json` with all required fields. The mock akshare module will raise FileNotFoundError if wrong adjust/period params are used, and ValueError if the wrong indicator string is passed, penalizing agents that guess parameters without reading the docs.
